description: Hessenberg 1..6, Bidiagonal of every shape, SymmetricTridiagonal 1..6, Schur eigenvalues (real / complex, general and structured spectra) 1..6, Parlett-Reinsch balancing 1..6 (WP 8.5-P16)

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: hessenberg1
ops.doc: a.hessenberg().unpack() = (q 1x1 orthogonal, h 1x1 upper Hessenberg, zeros below the subdiagonal), a = q h q^T, upstream Householder signs, general a
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 4 * A + 4 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: schur1_eigenvalues
ops.doc: a.try_schur(f64::EPSILON, 10000).unwrap().complex_eigenvalues() sorted by (re ascending, then im ascending), emitted as (re, im), general a (independent entries) (check the Schur factors by reconstruction)
ops.tolerance: ceil(64 + 32 * A * max(1, max |input|) + 256 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: schur1_eigenvalues_real
ops.doc: a.eigenvalues().unwrap() sorted ASCENDING, a = P diag(l) P^-1 (P well-conditioned) with a real, well-separated spectrum (pairwise gaps >= 0.1 max |l|)
ops.tolerance: ceil(64 + 32 * A * max(1, max |input|) + 256 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: schur2_eigenvalues_defective
